rdfs:label: dtend
rdfs:comment: The end date-time of an iCalendar Vevent — when the event finishes.
notes: Mirrors `dtstart`. RFC 5545 treats `dtend` as exclusive — an event from 15:00 to 16:00 has `dtend = 16:00` even though no event occurs at 16:00:00 itself. Distinct from `as:endTime` (ActivityStreams equivalent). May be xsd:date for all-day events (exclusive: a one-day event on 2026-04-19 has dtend 2026-04-20), so no single rdfs:range is declared. Mutually exclusive with `ical:duration`.

history.note: Dropped xsd:dateTime rdfs:range (all-day DTEND is a date); notes cover all-day exclusivity and ical:duration.
